summary: Worthington Enterprises filed an 8-K on August 31, 2026, disclosing that it amended and restated its existing five-year revolving credit facility on the same date. Aggregate commitments remain $500 million, with final maturity extended from September 27, 2028 to August 31, 2031. PNC Bank serves as administrative agent, with JPMorgan and Bank of America as syndication agents. The facility is unsecured and syndicated, and includes a $300 million incremental accordion. This is a routine credit-facility refinancing, not a special situation; there is no equity or M&A component to monitor for risk arbitrage.
